Based in Munich, Germany, with subsidiaries in Tokyo, Japan, and San Francisco, California, GenISys develops markets and supports flexible, high-performance software solutions for the optimization of micro- and nano- fabrication processes. Addressing the market for lithography and inspection, GenISys combines deep technical expertise in layout data processing, process modeling, correction and optimization with world class software engineering and a strong focus on ease of use for applications in IC prototyping, mask production, DfM development and MEMS. For electron- and laser beam direct write and mask manufacturing, our data preparation and proximity effect correction software helps to push the limits of technology. Since its foundation in 2005, GenISys has become a global market leader in the field of electron-beam lithography software and is expanding to related markets and applications.

  • LAB
    <p><strong>LAB</strong> is a comprehensive layout and process optimization platform for computational lithography and simulation. Designed to accelerate development and reduce production costs, LAB enables fast virtual exploration of large parameter spaces for projection, proximity, laser, and electron-beam lithography.</p><p>Key features include:</p><p><strong>Multi-Technology Support:</strong> Models projection, proximity, laser, and e-beam exposure tools within a single simulation platform.</p><p><strong>Advanced Simulation:</strong> Fast and accurate calculation of intensity images, aerial/bulk images, and 3D resist development modeling (including Mack4 and CAR models).</p><p><strong>Optimization & Verification:</strong> Supports Rule-based and Model-based Optical Proximity Correction (OPC), process window analysis (DOF, FEM, MEEF), and layout verification.</p><p><strong>VisualFLOW™ Interface:</strong> Intuitive drag-and-drop workflow creation with powerful 1D, 2D, and 3D visualization and automated metrology capabilities.</p>...   • TRACER
    <p><strong>TRACER</strong> is an advanced Monte Carlo simulation software designed to quantify electron-solid interactions and perform precise process calibration for electron-beam lithography. It enables users to accurately model electron scattering, analyze energy distribution, and generate essential Point Spread Functions (PSFs) required for effective Proximity Effect Correction (PEC).</p><p>Key features include:</p><p><strong>Monte Carlo Simulation:</strong> Rapidly computes electron scattering across arbitrary material stacks, accounting for primary and secondary electron spread and trajectory visualization.</p><p><strong>PSF Management & Analysis:</strong> Extracts 1D/2D PSFs, supports multi-Gaussian model fitting, averaging, and convolution, and seamlessly integrates with BEAMER for streamlined PEC workflows.</p><p><strong>Advanced Process Calibration:</strong> Determines critical parameters such as base dose, process blur, process bias, and lateral development using measured critical dimension (CD) data.</p><p><strong>Extensive Material Library:</strong> Includes a comprehensive built-in database of common semiconductors, metals, insulators, and resists, with easy creation of custom materials.</p>...   • ProSEM
    <p><strong>ProSEM</strong> is an advanced SEM metrology and automation package designed for fast, accurate measurement and analysis of micro- and nanostructures, process calibration, and lithographic patterns.</p><p>While modern lithography tools are highly automated, SEM-based metrology and inspection often remain manual and time-consuming. ProSEM provides an easy, automated, and reliable measurement solution for R&D institutions, multi-user facilities, and specialized manufacturing environments.</p><p>Key capabilities include:</p><p><strong>Automated SEM Metrology:</strong> Automated image analysis, line-width/CD measurement, line-edge roughness (LER), and contact hole analysis.</p><p><strong>Process Calibration & Optimization:</strong> Integrates seamlessly with simulation and PEC workflows to extract real-world process bias and parameters.</p><p><strong>High Efficiency & Reproducibility:</strong> Eliminates manual, operator-dependent measurement errors and streamlines data collection for fast batch processing.</p>...   • InSPEC
    <p><strong>InSPEC</strong> is an integrated SEM metrology and inspection software suite and upgrade kit that transforms standard scanning electron microscopes into advanced, automated inspection and metrology tools.
